company.name: RallyUp
company.body: I'm chief of staff and an investor at RallyUp. We build LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives: every post hand-written in their voice, engineered to reach the people who buy from them. This year we've shipped 700+ posts for leadership teams at PandaDoc, Letter.ai, Anchor Browser and Andel.
